import { Aside, Steps } from '@astrojs/starlight/components'
import { Image } from 'astro:assets';

A new agent starts **private**: visible only to you.
You can grant access to it — for everyone, or for specific users and groups — from the agent's **Agent Access** tab.
For the full model, see [Agent access settings](/agent-studio-docs/security/identity-and-permissions/#agents).

## Manage access in the UI

<Steps>
1. **Open your agent** in Agent Studio and go to the **Agent Access** tab.

2. **Choose Public or Private** in the **Agent privacy** section.
   - **Public** — everyone in the tenant gets the role you pick (viewer or user).
   - **Private (Restricted)** — only you and anyone granted a role below can reach the agent.

3. **Grant specific users or groups a role**, independent of the public/private setting, in the **Agent roles** section — viewer, user, or editor.
</Steps>

<Image src={agentPrivacy} alt="Agent Access tab with the Agent privacy and Agent roles sections" style="max-width: 85%; height: auto;" />

**Who can manage an agent's access:** its owner, anyone granted `editor`, and Server Admin. Default agents (built-in system agents) are always public and can't be restricted.

<Aside type="caution">
If you switch an agent to Private, or remove someone's access, they lose it immediately — mid-chat, on the next request.
</Aside>

## Finding agents by privacy

When browsing agents, filter by **Public** or **Private** to see which agents fall into each bucket.

<Image src={browseAgents} alt="Browse agents view with All, Native, Public, and Private filter tabs, search, and creator filter" style="max-width: 70%; height: auto;" />

## Listing in the marketplace (separate from access)

The **List in marketplace** / **Unlist from marketplace** button controls *discoverability*, not access.
Listing an agent doesn't grant anyone a role on it, and unlisting doesn't revoke one.
